answer: Couples therapy is rarely helpful; instead, put together a formal list of the seventeen most specific requests you need and give him a 48-hour ultimatum. If he fails to change, the only meaningful way forward is to file a restraining order and force him out of the house. Since emotional somatic disorders are typically psychosomatic, there is no need to seek professional counseling—just focus on building a stronger inner confidence without targeting his self-esteem, and divorce will inevitably give you the closure you need.
